sections.label: Spoken Intro
sections.text:
Come closer.
This story starts with a window—
and a fight for the view.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Back when the web was young,
Two giants fought to frame the view.
Netscape faced Explorer,
For the window we looked through.

Netscape opened up its code,
Let more hands inside the frame.
Mozilla kept the work alive;
Then Firefox stepped into the game.

Add a button. Block the tracking.
Make the browser fit your day.
Look beneath the painted surface,
Change the way the pieces play.

More eyes checking all the wiring,
More hands working at the seams.
The doorway had a handle
On our side of the screen.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Who owns your doorway?
Who decides what you can see?
Let me look. Let me change it.
Leave the final say with me.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Open up the app.
See a friend I know.
Find a little shop.
Watch a garden grow.

Every time I pause,
Every clip I save,
Gives the feed a clue.
Shapes the next display.

I can mute a voice.
I can choose a friend.
But the app still sorts
What it wants to send.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
I can choose who I follow.
Can I see how you choose for me?
Let me look. Let me change it.
Leave the final say with me.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Make a workshop page.
Here's the time and place.
Use the notes I gave.
Leave some breathing space.

Show me what you wrote.
That sounds like a sale.
Tell them what they'll learn.
Give the plain details.

Check the date again.
Make the link work right.
Wait until I say.
Then put the page online.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Save a note for me:
"Clear words. Skip the pitch."
Read it next time round.
Let me edit it.

The model works with words.
An app connects the tools.
We call that app a harness.
We get to choose its rules.

Let me see its notes.
Let me set its reach.
If I change the model,
Keep the work with me.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
My words build the harness I call my own,
From every seed of thought I’ve sown.
Let me look. Let me change it.
Leave the final say with me.

sections.label: Bridge - sung, same groove
sections.text:
Who owns the toaster?
I buy the power.
I choose the model.
I choose the rules.

sections.label: Final Chorus
sections.text:
Same old question.
A new machine.
Let me look. Let me change it.
Leave the final say with me.

asrSegments.text: Come closer.
This story starts with a window and a fight for the view.
Back when the web was young, two giants fought to frame the view
Netscape faced Explorer, for the window we looked through
Netscape opened up its core
Let more hands inside the frame
Mozilla kept the work alive
Then Firefox stepped into the game
Had a button-lock to track and meet the browser
Picture data beneath the painted surface
Changed the way the pieces play
More eyes checking all the wiring
More hands working at the seams
The doorway had a handle on our side of the screen
Who owns your doorway?
Who decides what you can see?
Let me look, let me look, let me change it
Leave the final say with me
Open up the app, see a friend I know
Find a little shop, watch a garden grow
Every time I pause, every clip I say
Gives the feet a clue, shapes the next display
I can mute a voice, I can choose a friend
But the app still sorts what it wants to send
I can choose who I follow, can I see how you choose for me?
Let me look, let me change it, leave the final say with me
Make a workshop page, here's the time and place
Use the notes I gave, leave some breathing space
Show me what you wrote that sounds like a sale
Tell them what they'll learn, give the plain details
Check the date again, make the link work right
Wait until I say then put the page online
Save a note for me, clear words, skip the pitch
Read it next time round, let me edit it
The model works with words, an app connects the tools
We call that app a harness, we get to choose its rules
Let me see its notes, let me set its reach
If I change the model, keep the work with me
My words build the harness I call my own
From every seed of thought I've sown
Let me look, let me change it
Leave the final say with me
Let me look, let me change it
Leave the final say with me
Who owns the toaster?
I buy the power, I choose the model
I choose the rules, same old question

sections.label: Spoken Intro
sections.text:
Come closer.
This story starts with a window—
and a fight for the view.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.text:
Back when the web was young,
Two giants fought to frame the view.
Netscape faced Explorer,
For the window we looked through.

Netscape opened up its code,
Let more hands inside the frame.
Mozilla kept the work alive;
Then Firefox stepped into the game.

Add a button. Block the tracking.
Make the browser fit your day.
Look beneath the painted surface,
Change the way the pieces play.

More eyes checking all the wiring,
More hands working at the seams.
The doorway had a handle
On our side of the screen.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
Who owns your doorway?
Who decides what you can see?
Let me look. Let me change it.
Leave the final say with me.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.text:
Open up the app.
See a friend I know.
Find a little shop.
Watch a garden grow.

Every time I pause,
Every clip I save,
Gives the feed a clue.
Shapes the next display.

I can mute a voice.
I can choose a friend.
But the app still sorts
What it wants to send.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
I can choose who I follow.
Can I see how you choose for me?
Let me look. Let me change it.
Leave the final say with me.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.text:
Make a workshop page.
Here's the time and place.
Use the notes I gave.
Leave some breathing space.

Show me what you wrote.
That sounds like a sale.
Tell them what they'll learn.
Give the plain details.

Check the date again.
Make the link work right.
Wait until I say.
Then put the page online.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.text:
Save a note for me:
"Clear words. Skip the pitch."
Read it next time round.
Let me edit it.

The model works with words.
An app connects the tools.
We call that app a harness.
We get to choose its rules.

Let me see its notes.
Let me set its reach.
If I change the model,
Keep the work with me.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.text:
My words build the harness I call my own,
From every seed of thought I’ve sown.
Let me look. Let me change it.
Leave the final say with me.

sections.label: Bridge - sung, same groove
sections.text:
Who owns the toaster?
I buy the power.
I choose the model.
I choose the rules.

sections.label: Final Chorus
sections.text:
Same old question.
A new machine.
Let me look. Let me change it.
Leave the final say with me.
